pay_experience_credit_indistrict_013.evidence: At the time of probationary appointment, if such teacher has previously served in the San Francisco Unified School District, unit members shall be placed in the appropriate classification and shall be allowed credit for increment purposes on the basis of one (1) increment for each year of service as a regularly assigned teacher.

pay_experience_credit_outofdistrict_014.evidence: A newly-appointed probationary unit member shall receive year-for-year credit for verified outside teaching or service in full-time permanent or probationary teacher, temporary, categorical, emergency or long-term substitute status. There shall be no limit on the number of year for year credit for verified outside teaching in full-time permanent or probationary teacher, temporary, categorical, emergency or long-term substitute status.

pay_national_board_017.evidence: National Board for Professional Teacher Standards (NBPTS) — A teacher who holds current NBPTS certification shall receive an added annual salary payment of $5,000 above regular salary schedule placement, provided that the teacher is teaching in a position for which he or she holds a current California teaching credential.
